summary: Implementation addresses all 13 tasks across 4 phases: orchestrator tests added to CI and Bandit scan, test isolation issues fixed (test_cli.py logging, test_devserver.py docker_client, test_input_fuzzing.py sys.modules pollution), pytest config consolidated from pytest.ini into pyproject.toml, mypy overrides added, documentation updated. All 4956 tests pass (83 skipped, 0 failures). Lint clean. New CI config validation tests (11) guard against future regressions. The --cov=orchestrator flag is intentionally excluded per plan to avoid disrupting the 80% coverage threshold. The analysis-identified issue of adding pull_request triggers to lint.yml/test.yml was reasonably scoped out of this implementation.
